reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(units) AS n_missing_units,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(net_revenue_eur) AS n_missing_revenue,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(unit_cost_eur) AS n_missing_cost
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
